title: PICACO: Pluralistic In-Context Value Alignment via Total Correlation Optimization
findings: The proposed PICACO method successfully aligned LLMs (such as GPT-3.5-Turbo and LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct) with the 'Confucianism' value composition, outperforming several baseline methods. This indicates its effectiveness in steering model outputs to reflect complex value systems with religious and philosophical dimensions, such as the respect for tradition inherent in Confucianism.
